pull-request-header:
## Description

Release-please collects the changes merged since the last release into this version and changelog update. It changes only `version.txt`, `.release-please-manifest.json` and `CHANGELOG.md`; merging it tags the release and starts the signed release workflow.
pull-request-footer:
## Pre-Merge Verification Checklist

- [ ] A maintainer read the diff and approved the pull request runs that GitHub holds for bot pull requests (CONTRIBUTING.md). The required checks block the merge until they pass: the CI job (workflow lint, interpreter pin, repository tests, manifest and allowlist checks), server-check, scanners, governance (praetor), analyze (python) and analyze (actions). CI does not run `make verify-all`, which stays a local check.
- [ ] Local verification passed: `make verify-all` on a checkout of the release branch (CI does not run `make verify-all`).
- [ ] The milestone check passes (rules: `check_release_mode` in the release-helper's `jellysin_tooling/milestone.py`). The label `release-ready` passes it, unless an open version milestone names a version other than this one or the next minor version (major.(minor+1).0), or two open milestones name the same version. Without the label, a release with patch 0 passes only when the milestone of this version is closed and no open milestone names this version; a patch release always needs the label.
- [x] No function, public interface or agent context changes, so the HISS, 3D test and context items do not apply.
- [x] The title follows Conventional Commits.
